archetypes.name: vote-parser-collision
archetypes.rationale: Alias acceptance is useful only if collision and parse-rate paths stay fail-closed.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the vote alias implementation for correctness. Focus on whether aliases are accepted only when the ballot id set makes them unambiguous, and whether parse-rate checking uses the same alias rule as final tallying. Check that primary ids win over aliases and that plan-review count, severity, and classification paths stay consistent. Cite specific files, functions, and tests in your review. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
